## Mission & Technology
- Tagline: "GO SOLAR, GO GREEN"

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Solar EPC Consulting & Site Feasibility Studies
- Engineering & Precision System Sizing
- Procurement of Tier-1 Solar Panels & Inverters
- Turnkey Installation & Grid Commissioning
- AP Discom Net Metering Documentation & Approvals
- Preventive Plant Maintenance & Performance Monitoring
- Solar Asset Management

## Solutions Offered
- Rooftop Solar: Grid-tied and hybrid systems for residential, commercial factories, and educational institutions.
- Ground Mount Solar: High-capacity multi-kilowatt and megawatt plants for open terrain, industrial spaces, and farms.
- Floating Solar: Reservoir and water-body mounted PV arrays saving land and minimizing water evaporation.
- Agricultural Solar Water Pumps: AC and DC submersible/surface solar pump systems for irrigation, poultry farms, and rural installations.
